title: Recycle!
description: A new block that lets you recycle your tools for Ingots!
body:
![RECYCLER](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/40de626cd118b827689accf71279fe8d838e31eb_0.webp)
The recycler is a super cool block that lets you _'recycle'_ your tools for their original resource! It uses the **power of souls** to power its blazing furnace..._ (power it with soul sand, if it wasnt obvious :>)
_
I hope to expand on this mod as it gains traction (if it does) and add many cool features.
![Blacksmiths Recycler: Ore Item + Soul Sand > Ingots (does'nt support netherite)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7c3b0fc3ec8d255daa4e84b076d787a85805506d.png)
and of course the normal but less useful Recycler!
![Wood Item + Coal > Planks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/110f98e5c73979877547af686e9eaed2e3a0363a.png)
